scope: Existing Windows callback adapter lifetime defect fix, offline regression validation and a non-executing fixed-read implementation proposal.

sdkDefect.documentedMeaning: Internal or user cancellation may not actually cancel the asynchronous operation.
sdkDefect.oldBehavior: Every Completed status was forwarded as a method terminal and could settle capture and resource ownership too early.
sdkDefect.observedPreFixOutcome: ReplyReceived classification and premature lifetime completion in SDK stand-ins; no valid protection value or charge-control success claim.
sdkDefect.fixedBehavior: Latch failure without forwarding CallCanceled as a terminal or settling capture; retain observer, selected output, owned inputs and lease until applicable actual final/call-exit/capture joins.
sdkDefect.laterFinal: An applicable final can join cleanup without promoting the earlier cancellation failure to success.
sdkDefect.ordinaryErrors: An applicable ordinary AccessDenied final preserves normal error cleanup.
sdkDefect.missingFinal: Related Run/Close can remain pending; no SDK Cancel, synthetic production final, retry or forced process termination.

targetReferenceEvidence.kind: Target reference assembly; enum metadata inspected as inert bytes, not loaded or executed

preFixReproduction.executor: Delegated SDK lifetime reviewer; root inspected the saved result, not a root pre-fix execution.

representativePlatformEvidence.authority: Official UDK2014 representative implementation, not normative PI text or a P05 binary match.
representativePlatformEvidence.referenceChain: Shared IPL bootstrap Context -> Core supplies actual Foundation entry -> registered normal entry -> inline typed management -> shared typed result -> NULL-root management -> return.

conditionalReadinessDecision.state: Concrete conditional implementation proposal; separate explicit approval required before new firmware invocation code.
conditionalReadinessDecision.criterionCorrection: Do not stack actual provider-body recovery and a separate common lock on top of accepted same-normal-stream ordering evidence.
explicitApplicabilityPremises: Normal proxy/private wrapper and backend initialization apply.
The normally registered Foundation entry invokes the related typed handler inline and finishes its relevant indexed work before return.
The entry belongs to the initialized, nonreentrant P05 normal stream already reviewed for the query.
Existing conditional ISA/bank/indexed-to-XDATA mapping and SDK/whole-exchange contracts apply.
concreteReevaluationTriggers: Evidence of related independent AP offload, direct-host/direct-dispatch or another execution domain.
Relevant indexed work deferred beyond handler return.
The assumed normal registration, initialization or nonreentrant stream does not apply.
conditionalReadinessDecision.newPurposeDurableAttemptReservation: Proposed only after separate approval; old consumed reservation is not read, reset, deleted, reused or bypassed.
conditionalReadinessDecision.readTransactionSideEffects: Existing communication-buffer/mailbox publication and response exchange remain; target mode and threshold writes are excluded.
conditionalReadinessDecision.successMeaning: Stored mode candidate 0 or 1 only; no threshold, actual charge limit or charge-control success claim.

distribution.scratchComparison: An attempted current App build-to-old-archive equality assertion did not pass; no cause is asserted and those new bytes are not distributed.

review.independentCodeAndRegressionReadReview: No blocking findings; execution evidence is the separate saved root build/suite run.
review.independentProposalAndFixDocumentReadRev: No blocking findings; assumptions distinguished from observations, scope and reservation/lifetime boundaries retained.
review.independentFinalStatusDocumentsAndSaniti: No blocking findings. Clarified the specification to say proposed approval scope rather than an already approved scope; review did not execute hardware or tests.

privacy: No local absolute paths, account names, device identifiers, raw frames, nonces, original firmware contents or raw exception text.
